command:
set -eu
export CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/target
cargo clean --release -p maximus-core -p maximus-http1 -p maximus-router -p maximus-runtime -p maximus-net -p maximus-io -p maximus-macros -p maximus
find /work/crates -name '*.rs' -exec touch {} +
cargo build --release --locked -p maximus --example hello
mkdir -p /target/2026-10-21/application-proof-baseline
cp /target/release/examples/hello /target/2026-10-21/application-proof-baseline/hello
cargo build --release --locked -p maximus --features sse --example sse-size
cp /target/release/examples/sse-size /target/2026-10-21/application-proof-baseline/sse
cargo build --release --locked -p maximus --features compression --example compression-size
cp /target/release/examples/compression-size /target/2026-10-21/application-proof-baseline/compression
cargo build --release --locked -p maximus --features sse,tls,http2 --example tls-sse-size
cp /target/release/examples/tls-sse-size /target/2026-10-21/application-proof-baseline/tls-sse
cargo build --release --locked -p maximus --all-features --example features
cp /target/release/examples/features /target/2026-10-21/application-proof-baseline/features
sha256sum /target/2026-10-21/application-proof-baseline/*
size /target/2026-10-21/application-proof-baseline/*
size -A /target/2026-10-21/application-proof-baseline/*
stat -c "%n %s" /target/2026-10-21/application-proof-baseline/*
